name: Madison
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Madison?
answer_short: Street-legal low-speed vehicles yes, plain golf carts no. In Madison, city code allows a low-speed vehicle on a roadway posted 35 mph or less. No ordinance allowing plain golf carts on those streets was found.

golf_cart.notes: No golf cart ordinance was found

lsv.notes: A connecting highway needs state consent. Objections are signed.

rules.rule: A low-speed vehicle may be operated on a roadway with a speed limit of 35 mph or less. A connecting highway or a state-trunk crossing needs Wisconsin DOT consent, and an objection is signed.
A municipality may allow golf carts on highways posted 25 mph or less. No Madison ordinance doing that was found.

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Madison?
faq.a: Roadways posted 35 mph or less. A connecting highway needs state consent. Objections are signed. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Madison?
faq.a: No. The city ordinance is for low-speed vehicles, and no golf cart ordinance was found.

faq.q: Where can I drive an LSV in Madison?
faq.a: On a roadway posted 35 mph or less, unless a sign says low-speed vehicles are prohibited.
